# Sponsor valentinfrlch/ha-llmvision
## Visual intelligence for your home.
**LLM Vision** is a Home Assistant integration that uses multimodal large language models to analyze images, videos, live camera feeds, and Frigate events. It can also keep track of analyzed events in a timeline, with an optional Timeline Card for your dashboard.

## Features
- Answers questions and provides descriptions of images, video files, live camera feeds, and Frigate events based on your prompt.
- Keeps a timeline of camera events, so you can display them on your dashboard or ask Assist about them.

## Blueprint
LLM Vision can also store events in a timeline, so you can see what happened on your dashboard.

## Introduction[Direct link to heading](https://llmvision.gitbook.io/getting-started#introduction)
### What is LLM Vision?[Direct link to heading](https://llmvision.gitbook.io/getting-started#what-is-llm-vision)
LLM Vision is a Home Assistant integration that leverages multimodal LLMs to analyze images, videos, and live camera feeds, answer questions about them, and update sensors based on extracted data.

### Architecture[Direct link to heading](https://llmvision.gitbook.io/getting-started#architecture)
It is triggered by a camera or binary sensor state change. Optionally, the analyzed "event", can also be saved in the timeline.
